item.title: Age Caps Are Blocking Experienced Doctors From Specialist Training — Medical Officer
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The public health system needs more specialists, yet rigid age limits block long-serving doctors from specialist training, even if self-funded. The policy risks wasting experienced talent and undermining efforts to expand the public sector specialist workforce. item.title: Master’s Graduates Run Hospitals On ‘Study Leave’ But Can’t Apply For Subspecialty Training — Physician
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
A requirement for three consecutive full-year LNPT reports may delay subspecialty training for Master’s graduates by several years. One doctor says this is because Master’s training is classified as “study leave”, despite trainees continuing to run wards, clinics, and on-calls. item.title: Coronary Stent Excluded From Civil Servants’ GL Coverage In Public Hospitals: UiTM
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
UiTM says coronary stents are not covered under civil servants’ guarantee letters (GL) for treatment in UiTM Hospital, in line with procedures in MOH hospitals. Stents are categorised as special devices, for which applicants can request financial aid. item.title: Teen Pregnancy Data Is Incomplete Without Abortion Figures — Dr SP Choong
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Dr SP Choong argues teen pregnancy data cited in a Ministry of Health report is misleading because it counts only hospital births, not abortions. He says the issue must also address access to safe, legal abortion and accurate information.
